generations.prompt: A woman lies on her back in a meadow pointing up at a single cloud. She holds the point with complete conviction, then tilts her head, reconsiders, lowers her arm a little, and points again, firmly, happy with her answer. The small white cloud drifts very slowly across the sky. The grass stirs in a light breeze. Audio: a skylark singing high overhead, a light breeze in the grass, distant summer countryside quiet. The camera is locked off on a tripod: completely fixed, no camera movement, no pan, no tilt, no zoom, no cut. Bright flat natural daylight, naturalistic and unstaged. No music. No speech, nobody talks. No on-screen text, no captions, no subtitles, no watermark.
